articles.title: Real Estate Funds Slip After Trump Says He Plans to Ban Investors From Buying Homes
articles.mainIdea: Real Estate Funds Slip After Trump Says He Plans to Ban Investors From Buying Homes
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Real Estate Funds Slip After Trump Says He Plans to Ban Investors From Buying Homes. Real estate funds felt the jitters from President Donald Trump's plan to ban large investors from buying homes. Exchange-traded funds iShares U.S. Real Estate, Vanguard Real Estate, and State Street Real Estate Select Sector–which are among the largest real estate ETFs–fell into negative territory minutes after Trump said he would call on Congress to ban institutional investors from buying more single-family homes. Related tickers mentioned: IYR, VGSIX, VGSLX, VGSNX, XLRE.
